[fridgejam] Just had an big order canceled loosening big cashback and Ali voucher, so these could be useful, especially with upsized cashback!
[kaikor] Silly me, only discovered using the app via coins page have such a BIG damn differences in prices, even items in cart between browser and app are so crazy different, bought diecast which is 40% discount on top using coins !!!
Any other tricks to bring more prices down?
[Clear] Coins is the best way. You'll find during sale periods the discounts are a lot better. When monthly budgets have been exhausted outside of sales the discounts are super meh.
Many of the deals I post will often show up cheaper in the Coins section too.
[kaikor] Yeah but playing those stupid games in the app is very time consuming …
[Clear] Games are for gems that get redeemed for vouchers. Just check in daily for up to 50 a day and make orders.
[SeanConnery] Yep, key is to always use the search function within the Coins section itself too. One item might have further 20% off with coins, and using the search, another seller with the same identical item you're buying might have 90% off with coins.
[Mel-waukee] Can I order an electric car? I hope I'll get free delivery.

My last order came shipped from China today and only took a record 4 days to arrive. I have no idea why it was so fast as it was standard shipping and was the Xteink X4 Pro ereader. Which btw is a fantastic device.

[SometimesStingy] You just change the currency, then when you pay it’s in USD, that’s all. Personally I’ve noticed on geo hundred dollar orders it’s less than a dollar difference so I just leave it in Aud and use the coupons anyway.
